sections.title: What is Jeevan Umang (Plan 945)?
sections.description: A brief overview of this popular whole-life income plan.

content.text: Jeevan Umang is a **participating whole-life plan** that provides an ongoing (lifelong) survival income after the premium paying term. It combines life insurance protection with a recurring income stream — making it attractive for retirement planning. The plan also accrues bonuses and may include final additional bonuses where applicable. You can get more details from the official LIC Jeevan Umang page.

sections.title: How the LIC Jeevan Umang Calculator Works
sections.description: The formulas and assumptions behind your benefit calculation.

content.heading: Premium Calculation
content.body: The calculator uses LIC's base premium rates based on your age, sum assured, and PPT. It then applies standard modal loading factors for non-yearly payments and adds GST (4.5% 1st year, 2.25% thereafter).

content.heading: Survival & Maturity Benefits
content.body: The primary benefit is the annual survival income, which is a guaranteed 8% of your Basic Sum Assured, paid every year after your premium term ends, until you reach age 100. The maturity benefit, paid at age 100, includes the Sum Assured, vested bonuses, and any Final Additional Bonus (FAB).

sections.title: Worked Examples & Case Studies
sections.description: See how Jeevan Umang performs for different life stages.

content.heading: Case Study 1: The Young Professional (Age 30, ₹10L Cover, PPT 15)
content.body: Goal: Build a tax-free pension alternative. Inputs: Age 30, BSA ₹10L, PPT 15. Result: Approx. yearly premium of ₹65,000. From age 46, they receive a guaranteed, tax-free income of ₹80,000 every year for life. By age 75, they would have received ₹24 Lakhs in income from a total premium payment of about ₹9.75 Lakhs, while the life cover continues.

content.heading: Case Study 2: The Pre-Retiree (Age 50, ₹25L Cover, PPT 10)
content.body: Goal: Create a supplementary, guaranteed income stream in retirement. Inputs: Age 50, BSA ₹25L, PPT 10. Result: Approx. yearly premium of ₹2.7 Lakhs. From age 61, they receive a guaranteed annual income of ₹2,00,000. This provides a secure income floor, unaffected by market volatility in their retirement years.

content.heading: Case Study 3: Child's Future (Child Age 1, Parent Age 30)
content.body: Goal: Create a lifelong financial gift for a child. Inputs: Child Age 1, Parent Age 30, BSA ₹5L, PPT 20. Result: Approx. premium of ₹22,875/year. From the child's 22nd birthday, they start receiving ₹40,000 annually, for life. It serves as a supplementary income for their early career and a valuable asset for life.

sections.title: Loan Calculation Example
sections.description: Understand how you can get liquidity from your policy without surrendering it.

content.text: If you've paid premiums for 5 years on a ₹10 Lakh policy, your policy might have a Special Surrender Value (SSV) of around ₹2.5 Lakhs (illustrative). You can typically get a loan of up to 90% of this amount, which would be ₹2.25 Lakhs, to meet any immediate financial needs. The loan amount and accrued interest are then adjusted against the final claim amount.

sections.title: Frequently Asked Questions
sections.description: All your questions about the Jeevan Umang Calculator answered.

items.q: What is the Jeevan Umang calculator and is it free?
items.a: The Jeevan Umang calculator is a free online tool to estimate premiums, survival income and related values for LIC Plan 945. Results are illustrative, not a binding quote.

items.q: How do I calculate Jeevan Umang premium?
items.a: Enter your age, BSA, and PPT into the calculator. The tool uses official LIC rate tables and modal factors to compute your premium.

items.q: What is the survival income under Jeevan Umang?
items.a: It is a guaranteed annual payment of 8% of the Basic Sum Assured, paid every year after the Premium Paying Term ends, until age 100 or death.

items.q: Are the results from this LIC calculator accurate?
items.a: The premium calculations are highly accurate based on LIC's rules. The maturity benefits are estimates as they depend on future, non-guaranteed bonuses. Always get an official illustration from LIC.

items.q: When can I take a loan against Jeevan Umang?
items.a: You can typically avail a loan after the policy has acquired a surrender value, which is after two full years of premium payments.

items.q: Is the survival income from Jeevan Umang taxable?
items.a: Under current tax laws (Section 10(10D)), the proceeds from LIC policies, including survival benefits, are generally tax-free, subject to certain conditions.

conclusion.title: Final Verdict: Is Jeevan Umang a Good Investment?
conclusion.body: For individuals seeking a disciplined, low-risk savings plan that provides a guaranteed, lifelong, tax-free income stream, Jeevan Umang is one of the most robust products in the market. It excels at creating a predictable 'pension' alternative, shielded from market volatility. It may not offer the high growth of equity, but for foundational financial security, its value is unmatched.
